input.summary: P4 stair strip (x54, z10..15) is one cell wide and the attic flight fills it, so no furniture fits. The part is one hanging lantern at (54,6,15), which lights the whole strip (min 13, 0 dark).
left: Walk verdict UNREACHABLE for the strip: the way in (parlour west door (53,3,10) into (54,3,10)) and the parlour/shell A are stubs in this copy, so the room's 3 floor cells z13..15 are not reached from the entrance. Re-run `room` after the full merge.

waste.what: No single tool reports the strip's free cells per level with the flight's stringers marked, so I worked out by hand which of x54 z10..15 are stair, stringer or free.
waste.tool: `plan --only` could tag stair and stringer cells per floor level (o is ambiguous).
